newsitem.title: USA: Oshkosh Truck awarded $31.5 million Army contract.
newsitem.headline: Oshkosh Truck awarded $31.5 million Army contract.

text.p: Oshkosh Truck Corp. said Tuesday that the U.S. Army awarded it a $31.5 million contract for 126 heavy equipment transporters.
The contract contains an option to purchase 324 additional units. The new order adds to a contract awarded in January 1990, the Oshkosh, Wis.-based company said.
Production of the M1070 heavy equipment transporter is scheduled to begin in September and be completed in July 1997, it said.

The M1070 features an eight-wheel-drive tractor and six-person cab. It was designed for movement of the M1A1/M1A2 main battle tank, but also transports other tanks, fighting and recovery vehicles, self-propelled howitzers and construction equipment in difficult military operating environments.
Oshkosh said M1070s are operating with the U.S. Army worldwide and are prime transporters in Bosnia.
Oshkosh manufactures a wide variety of specialised trucks and transportation equipment for defence, fire and emergency, and commercial use.
Its stock rose 25 cents to $12.375 on Nasdaq in late morning trading.
